title: Input Trigger
description: UI component that triggers actions in response to player input.
content:
Input Trigger

UI component that listens for player input and triggers actions or commands in response.

Component UI

Schema

JSON
"inputTrigger": {
  "input": "...",
  "onTrigger": [],
  "consumeInput": true
}

Description

The InputTrigger component binds a specific player input action to a set of commands that execute when that input is detected. It is used to create UI-driven keybinds, shortcut actions, and input-responsive elements. The component can optionally consume the input event to prevent it from propagating to other systems.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
inputstringThe input action name to listen for (e.g., "confirm", "cancel", "menu").
onTriggerstring[]Array of commands to execute when the input is detected.
consumeInputboolWhether to consume the input event and prevent further propagation.

Example

JSON
{
  "components": {
    "inputTrigger": {
      "input": "cancel",
      "onTrigger": ["closeMenu", "playSound ui_back"],
      "consumeInput": true
    }
  }
}
